purpose: Close the remaining real-source gap for hero head reconstruction, full-body rigging, Move AI mocap, facial performance and 30-second continuity proof.

globalRules.subject: Adam Clamp
globalRules.lighting: soft frontal light; avoid hard overhead shadows
globalRules.background: plain, uncluttered, no sensitive documents or identifiers
globalRules.captureTiming: Do not require capture while visibly exhausted. Record when Adam is rested enough to represent his intended launch appearance.
globalRules.posture: upright, relaxed, natural; do not slouch for the identity pass
globalRules.perspective: avoid close wide-angle distortion; step back and use a normal/tele perspective when practical
globalRules.transientStatePolicy: temporary fatigue, eye shadows, puffiness, bloating, redness, slouching, and lens distortion are not canonical identity traits
globalRules.bodyPresentationPolicy: do not artificially slim or fitness-enhance; also do not let unflattering lens/posture/transient-state distortion make the canonical avatar look heavier than stable real-source evidence

sequence: natural pause, look away and return
requiredCoverage: glasses if launch appearance uses them

clips.camera: locked; full body centered; feet and hands continuously visible

promotionRule: Capture completion does not itself certify likeness, voice, motion or Gold Master. It unlocks reconstruction and literal QA.
